4406734.name: Chabad of Westboro Village
4406734.note: COLlive, 3 June 2019 ('New Shluchim to Ottawa, Canada'): 'Rabbi Dovid and Mushky Caytak (nee Sirota), along with their family, are going to be moving on Shlichus to found Chabad of the Westboro area of Ottawa', under Rabbi Dovid Hayes. Its chabad.org listing went up 30 July 2019 (it names no director).
